summary: Paper demonstrates strong numerical accuracy with all core quantitative claims (ρ_j medians, p-values, Cohen's d, NLI distributions, autocorrelations) matching ground truth exactly. Three MAJOR issues identified: (1) '50×' approximation is imprecise (should be '20-80×'); (2) 'expected range 0.75-0.85' not consistently cited as INFERRED; (3) sample sizes and experimental parameters missing from ground truth file for independent verification. One FATAL issue: critical experimental parameters (N=792, N=817, claims/sample) cannot be independently verified from ground truth file. Despite these issues, the paper's core argument (measurement validity failure) remains valid, and limitations section appropriately acknowledges uncertainty in expected range. Recommend: (1) revise '50×' to '20-80× depending on domain' for precision; (2) add consistent citation '(inferred from CCP paper's +0.05-0.10 ROC-AUC claims; see Section 3.1)' to all expected-range mentions; (3) add experimental parameters to ground truth YAML.
